We have an open Ph.D. position in connection with the NordForsk-funded RAID (Responsive Use of AI in Interaction Design) project.

You have a chance of doing a Ph.D. with us here in Aarhus in one of the biggest Human-Computer Interaction communities in Europe.

The Ph.D. will explore the emerging paradigm of generative user interfaces (GenUI): UIs where what the user interacts with is partially or fully generated to fit their needs, skills, circumstances, or preferences using generative artificial intelligence.

We are particularly concerned with how this can be done in a way so professional computer users maintain control, ownership, and autonomy.

We are looking for a candidate with a background in Computer Science, Human–Computer Interaction, or related fields. The candidate must have an interest in research on human-AI interaction techniques and human-centered AI. Strong software development skills and software understanding is a must.

The deadline for applying is August 1st 2026 with a start of the Ph.D. in January 2027.
